title.narrative: Strengthening Capacity of local humanitarian actors in Zimbabwe

description.narrative:
The project targets to create a centralised and comprehensive platform that is accessible to all local humanitarian actors in Buhera. The platform will be designed to enhance the capacity of local humanitarian actors through integrated and innovative practices to address the key issues of capacity strengthening and networking for effective humanitarian response to save lives and build resilience of disaster-affected communities. Through this platform, the humanitarian actors will share knowledge, best practices, good standards and procedures and challenges together with recommendations. Furthermore, through the platform, there will be improved collaboration and coordination of the humanitarian actors. The platform budded Humanitarian Learning Hub is an innovative approach as it will be a digital library that will act as a centralised knowledge repository. Various resources will be accessed on the platform including toolkits, guidelines, standard operating procedures, best practices, lessons learnt from previous projects, case studies among others. This will help to ensure that all the interested humanitarian actors have access to up-to-date information, guidelines and evidence-based best practices addressing knowledge gaps that hinder effective humanitarian responses.
The project proposes the creation of a Community of Practice for humanitarian actors to meet periodically (physically and or virtually) to share experiences, and challenges, ask questions, and collaborate on solutions to common challenges. Through the Community of Practice, a culture of continuous learning and adaptation will be developed within the local humanitarian actors, thus enhancing actors’ ability to effectively support disaster affected communities. To enhance the knowledge and skills of the staff, the project proposes to facilitate training programs through webinars, workshops and various courses related to humanitarian work in the face of climate change and disasters. Thus training programs will focus on emergency response, disaster risk reduction, climate adaptation and humanitarian standards and principles.
